description: [Kyreos, 0.001 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Current Base gas price in wei and gwei from a public RPC. One call, JSON back. Built from what paying wallets already buy: chain reads. Input: {}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/base-gas-price?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.001 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.001 USDC on Base)
